rationale: The Latin anchors (expandi manus meas ad te, ad te levavi animam meam, ad te levavi oculos meos, exaltabit caput) all express the literal upward lifting/raising of hands, soul, and eyes toward God, directly corresponding to heave.v.04 "lift or elevate." The other senses (throwing, waving, breathing, etc.) are not supported by the Latin or the Psalms context.
